summary: Fixed three bugs: clipped tab labels on phones (Agents, video page), a '1 warnings' badge, and 'Resolve all' closing setting proposals without a decision. Added two ideas from Friday's trend check.
why: Phone screenshots showed the Agents tabs cut off; reading the Notifications page found that Resolve all could silently drop a proposal the owner must approve or decline. All checks pass (51 smoke tests).

findings.title: Agents tabs clipped on phones
findings.detail: 'Experiments (1)', 'Topic feed (1)' and 'Merge log' wrapped inside a fixed-height bar.

findings.title: Resolve all swept up proposals
findings.detail: A proposal resolved this way could no longer be approved.
